articles.title: Gildan Named Most Attractive Place to Work in Honduras’ Manufacturing Sector for Fifth Consecutive Year

articles.summary: Gildan welcomes today's announcement by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) that it has closed its narrow investigation into Gildan, which had focused on a single provision in Gildan’s sales incentive agreement with one of its wholesale distributor customers.
articles.title: Gildan Releases Statement Regarding FTC Inquiry

articles.summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. (“Gildan” or the “Company”) today announced it has completed the previously announced sale of HanesBrands Australia (“HAA”) to BBFIT Investments Pte Ltd, an associated entity of BB Retail Capital, a global private investment firm, for approximately $700 million Australian dollars (approximately $490 million US dollars), paid in cash at closing.
articles.title: Gildan Completes Sale of HanesBrands Australia

articles.summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL; TSX and NYSE) will report its 2026 third quarter financial and operating results on Thursday, November 5, 2026. A press release will be issued before markets open, and a conference call is scheduled on that same day at 8:30 AM ET to discuss the Company’s results.
articles.title: Gildan Activewear Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
